summary: Finish (done, already) flips two open hands from palms-in to palms-out, once. It also marks the past tense in ASL.
steps: Hold both open hands up, palms facing you.
Flip them outward so the palms face away.
One quick flip. Doubled and small, it can mean 'that's enough.'
mistakes: Flipping slowly. It's a quick, decisive flip.
